items.title: Do earlier best zones stay better?

source.label: Shown Space database exports
caveats: Computation uses the October 12 export; October 24 live season counts match but row contents were not refetched.
These are exploratory historical checks, including a previously inspected 2026 season. Associations do not establish a causal benefit from changing release location.
Historical rates are optimistic because the best-looking zone is selected from those outcomes.
Intervals resample the 48 players 5,000 times and are conditional on historical selection; pooled throw rates use different weights.

evidenceFlow.title: Independent recalculation
evidenceFlow.detail: A separate csv-reader implementation matched all 22,386 huck attempts, 13,836 completions, the 48 selected player-zone pairs, and the 2026 counts of 139/201 versus 438/660.

evidenceFlow.title: Source coverage
evidenceFlow.detail: SHA-256 hashes matched the recorded export manifest. Game and throw counts matched the saved live query for every season. No duplicate game/throw keys or orphan GameIDs were found.

metricDefinitions.label: Chosen-zone advantage
metricDefinitions.definition: The mean difference between each player’s completion rate in their historically selected zone and their rate elsewhere, giving each player equal weight.

metricDefinitions.label: Huck
metricDefinitions.definition: A nonstall pass with forward gain strictly over 30 yards and straight-line distance strictly over 40 yards.

filters: Identity: source player IDs, excluding unnamed throwers
Historical eligibility: 40 hucks and two zones with at least 10 attempts
Selection: highest historical zone completion, ties by attempts then zone ID
Evaluation: 2026 attempts both inside and outside the chosen zone

preview.note: Same 48 testable players in both periods.
